profileText: a Representative from New Jersey; born in Newark, Essex County, N.J., on June 20, 1986; graduated from Central High School, Newark, N.J., 2004; B.A., Bloomfield College, Bloomfield, N.J., 2008; M.A., Seton Hall University, South Orange, N.J., 2011; staff, Newark Public Schools, Newark, N.J., 2006-2013; human resources manager; non-profit executive; member of the Newark, N.J., city council, 2018-2024, president, 2022-2024; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Eighteenth Congress, by special election, to fill the vacancy caused by the death of United States Representative Donald Payne Jr., and reelected to the succeeding Congress (September 18, 2024-present).
